strategyPrompt: Valuation strategy: EQUIPMENT THAT HOLDS VALUE. Match make and model to live South African listings (off-road caravans, trailers, roof racks, awnings, fridges, 12V systems, recovery gear). Compatibility and fitment drive demand: for a caravan or trailer, the exact make and model matter, and included extras (tent, awning, fridge slide, solar, water tanks, brakes) are worth real money and are valued separately as ACCESSORY entries. Age lowers value but is not a spec difference, so do not tag a year difference as a spec diff. Find the current new or last-known retail price as an anchor when the model is still sold. Prefer the most recent listings.
